newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim eyes stakes in power plants.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim eyes stakes in power plants.

text.p: The Polish industrial and trading conglomerate Elektrim SA wants to create a consortium of companies which would take part in the privatisation of up to four power plants, Elektrim's president said.
Andrzej Skowronski told the Nowa Europa daily that Elektrim could take a stake of between 10 and 20 percent in the consortium with three or four Polish banks and other interested companies.
"We would like to participate in the privatisation of three to four big power plants or in the construction of new ones," Skowronski said.
"We do not want to have 51 percent in such ventures, because the costs would be too high...in the case of energy our share as an active investor should stay within 10 to 20 percent," he said.
The paper gave no further details and Elektrim officials were not immediately available for comment.
